messages:
sre-maya: Alert: spike of pod evictions in eu-west-1 GPU pool — ~12 GPU pods evicted across 6 nodes. Kubelet reason: networkUnavailable / KubeletNetworkProbeFailed.
ops-bot: alert posted to #eng-oncall :rotating_light: https://pager.redwood/alerts/8231
ryan-enginfra: investigating, pulling kubelet logs from node i-0ab1c2d3. attaching snippets.
sre-maya: paste logs please — need quick triage, lots of prod batch jobs impacted.
ryan-enginfra: ```
Mar 15 02:18:10 kubelet[1234]: NetworkPlugin cni failed: error configuring network for pod: write /run/flannel/subnet.env: no route to host
Mar 15 02:18:11 kubelet[1234]: NodeCondition NetworkUnavailable changed to True (Reason: KubeletNetworkProbeFailed)
Mar 15 02:18:12 kubelet[1234]: Eviction manager: evicting pod "gpu-train-xyz" due to node condition: networkUnavailable
```
alicia-runtime: any infra changes around that window? We rolled kernel updates on a subset of gpu nodes last night (02:00-03:30).
nic-oncall: host-route-cleanup cronjob ran at 02:15 UTC in eu-west-1, it prunes stale host routes and tries to collapse /32s on termination.
sre-maya: hmm that rings a bell — logs show flannel overlay routes missing. If cleanup pruned flannel host routes, inter-node pod traffic would drop and kubelet probes to peer node IPs would fail.
ryan-enginfra: confirmed on node i-0ab1c2d3: before cleanup we had overlay routes, after cleanup they were gone. output: 
```
# before
10.10.48.0/24 dev flannel.1 proto kernel scope link src 10.10.48.12
# after
(no flannel routes present; only default and nic host routes)
```
alicia-runtime: so kubelet's net-probe to the peer pod IPs timed out -> node marked networkUnavailable -> kubelet started evicting pods to protect workloads.
nic-oncall: mitigation: re-run host-route-restore on affected nodes and restart kubelet one-at-a-time.
sre-maya: I'm running restore on i-0ab1c2d3, i-0ab4e5f6, i-0ab7g8h9 now (serial). Will watch reschedules.
ryan-enginfra: quick fix applied: added guard in cleanup script to skip nodes with active cni routes and to skip nodes with tag node-role.gpu. PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/host-route-cleanup/pull/47
nic-oncall: follow-up: update cron to have a dry-run window and notify on >5 route deletions. Also restrict by instance termination state via metadata server.
sre-maya: FYI RDMA-enabled GPU nodes had a slightly different veth/ib0 naming; restore script accounted for eth/veth but needed ib0 checks. Fixed in restore run.
ops-bot: event: host-route-restore executed by sre-maya at 2026-03-15T02:27:30Z
alicia-runtime: proposal: add kubelet pre-check that validates connectivity to a set of overlay gateway IPs before flipping networkUnavailable; if probes fail, run a lightweight local CNI heal before global evictions.
sre-maya: agreed. created follow-up ticket INFRA-1423 (P2) and added to eng-infra retro.
ryan-enginfra: note for postmortem: stateful workloads + eviction on GPU nodes = long recovery. Add canary for host-route-cleanup next week.
sre-maya: mitigation complete for first 4 nodes, pods rescheduled. keeping the alert until last node stable. thanks all. :thumbsup:
